proofStanding: exact per-move denominator when child enumeration completes; UNKNOWN games on any timeout; heuristic observation over the fixed policy/level/seed panel

definitions.halfScoreMove: first move reaching half the final score, divided by moves used
definitions.greedRatio: mean per-move points divided by the exact maximum legal-chain points on that pre-move board
definitions.player: selects the strong-settings greedy candidate nearest a fixed fraction of that candidate pool maximum

panel.termination: every arm plays to its shipped move budget or a genuine terminal state; target crossing records a win but does not stop play

P1.required: SUPPORTED at the complete 128-game matrix, >=75% exact-complete games overall, and >=50% in every percentile/level cell; FALSIFIED below 50% overall, an incomplete matrix, or a percentile with no exact games

P2.required: SUPPORTED when exact mean greed rises strictly with the scripted percentile and spans >=0.30; FALSIFIED when unordered, missing, or spanning <0.15

P3.required: SUPPORTED when policy-level win rate and exact mean greed have Pearson r >=0.50; FALSIFIED at r <=0

P4.required: SUPPORTED when per-game score and exact greed have |r| <0.70; FALSIFIED at |r| >=0.85

P5.required: SUPPORTED when every percentile policy lands in its modal or edge-adjacent cell on >=80% of exact-complete games; FALSIFIED below 60%

P6.required: SUPPORTED when both axes occupy all three frozen bins and at least five cells; FALSIFIED when timing occupies one bin, greed fewer than two, or at most three cells
